messages:
alex_rm: Prod-eu embeddings returning intermittent 503s since 03:14 UTC. Root cause points to header parser loop causing kvcache OOM under spike. I built image r2026-hotfix. Requesting expedited hotfix deploy (skip full canary) within next 15m. Ops + SRE approval needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: service=embeds-service-prod-eu image=r2026-hotfix release-window=immediate. Policy: skip-canary=false. Required approvals: 2 (ops, sre). To approve run `/approve deploy 1762468243` or react with :white_check_mark:.

kim_dev: ran staging load tests earlier — no obvious regressions. Script used: `scripts/loadrun --rps 150 --dur 5m`. Staging 99th latency ~430ms, errors 0. Logs: `staging/embeds-service: no kvcache spikes`.

maria_sre: can we get a quick smoke telemetry snapshot from prod-eu before we touch anything? need cpu/mem + 99th p99 over the last 10m.

ops_doug: we need pinned release info + a rollback image before greenlight. Pin target? rollback image? confirm no DB migrations.

alex_rm: pin -> r2026-hotfix, rollback -> r2025. No DB migrations or config schema changes. Rollback plan: 1) `deployctl rollback --service embeds-service-prod-eu --image r2025` 2) swap traffic back to stable pool 3) scale down canary pods. I'll paste the runbook in 2s.

rachael_pm: impact note: medium for subset of EU customers using embeddings. Approve expedited from product side.

devex_bot: Draft release notes created: https://internal/releasenotes/1762468243 (please review the short description field).

maria_sre: :white_check_mark: Approve. Quick check of prod telemetry: p99=420ms, mem steady, small spike in kvcache misses around 03:12 correlating with errors. Staging after patch looks fine.

ops_doug: :white_check_mark: Approve. I will monitor logs and be ready to execute rollback steps. Adding myself to pager duty for the next 45m.

deploy-bot: Approvals received (2). Initiating controlled rollout: canary 10% -> monitor 3m -> promote. Executing: ```deployctl rollout start --service embeds-service-prod-eu --image r2026-hotfix --canary 10 --timeout 3m --requester alex_rm```

deploy-bot: Canary started. New pods: embeds-prod-eu-r2026-1 (Ready), embeds-prod-eu-r2026-2 (Ready). Observability: streaming logs and canary metrics to https://telemetry/internal/embeds/1762468243-canary

deploy-bot: Canary metrics after 3m: errors=0, p99=440ms, throughput nominal. kvcache misses back to baseline. Promoting to 100% per rollout policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment status: SUCCESS. Release URL: https://deployments.redwood/1762468243.

alex_rm: thanks team. I'll keep an eye on dashboards and close this thread in 30m if no regressions.

rachael_pm: release notes updated: "fix: embeddings 503s in EU - header parsing causing kvcache OOM (r2026-hotfix)".

ops_doug: monitoring ok so far, no alerts. Standing by for 30m, will trigger rollback if any surge.

maria_sre: added a regression alert for p50/p99 delta >20% for the next 1h.

alex_rm: closing on successful deploy unless we see anything. Great coordination, :tada:
